lines.zh: 我一节一节地挪，粉色的背在抖。
lines.en: I inch along, my pink back quivering.
My feet grip the vein and I walk slowly.
The leaf's edge is my road.
I move over, and the leaf dips.

lines.zh: 我数着自己的节往前走。
lines.en: I count my own segments as I go.

lines.zh: 粉色的绒毛在阳光下发亮。
lines.en: Pink fuzz shines in the sun.
I go around the hole in the leaf.
I reach the tip, then turn back.
I chew my way along, leaving a track.
I flip from the underside to the top.

lines.zh: 雨滴打下来，我紧贴叶子。
lines.en: Rain hits; I press flat to the leaf.
My body is soft, so I move slowly.
Each segment plants before lifting.
I follow the midrib to a fork.

lines.zh: 这片叶子够大，能走很久。
lines.en: This leaf is big enough to walk a while.
I shift to the shaded side.

lines.zh: 我趴着，像一小段粉色的线。
lines.en: I lie still, a small pink thread.
I lift my head and sway.
Half-chewed, I pause.

lines.zh: 叶子上有我咬出的圆洞。
lines.en: The leaf has round holes from me.

lines.zh: 我在叶心慢慢嚼着早餐。
lines.en: In the leaf's heart I chew my breakfast.

lines.zh: 我数着叶脉的分叉发呆。
lines.en: I stare, counting the forks of the vein.
An ant passes nearby.
I rub my mouthparts on the vein.

lines.zh: 阳光透过叶片，绿得发亮。
lines.en: Sun through the leaf glows green.
I dare not leave this leaf.
A thin powder coats my back.
One more bite, and I grow a little.
You are blocking my light.
Your finger is enormous.
I am on this leaf. Do not step.
You could move me elsewhere.
I have no teeth. I do not bite.
Pink stands out in the jungle.
Leaves are the only thing I chew.
Do not touch my leaf.
Do you mean to bottle me?

lines.zh: 我仰头看你，粉背露了出来。
lines.en: I look up, my pink back exposed.
I roll myself into a half circle.
Two segments ache.
My fuzz is messed up.
I move onto the vein to hide.
The pain makes me sway both ways.
A little green fluid seeps out.
The leaf has a little water on it.
I score the leaf with my grip.
I can still take two more bites.

lines.zh: 粉色的身子疼得蜷起来。
lines.en: My pink body curls up in pain.
A leaf. Is it tender?
That new leaf. For me.

lines.zh: 我别的都不要，只要树叶。
lines.en: I want nothing but leaves.

lines.zh: 叶子一离开，我就活不了。
lines.en: Off a leaf, I cannot live.
Put me on that leaf.
This leaf's veins are too tough.
Do not tempt me with fruit.
I smell a fresh shoot.
A bit closer. I cannot reach.
This one leaf will last a while.
You touched me, and I flinched.
The stem bends; I grab hold.
Gently. I am soft.

lines.zh: 粉色的尾巴被你踩住了。
lines.en: You've stepped on my pink rear.
I roll my body into a small ball.
You set the leaf swinging.
My feet still have a firm grip.
Do not push me off the edge.
I shifted over toward the vein.
A slight shift is all it takes.
Ask again after I pupate and emerge.
I must make the chrysalis first.
Ask after I become a butterfly.

lines.zh: 没有翅膀的毛虫不谈这些。
lines.en: A wingless caterpillar doesn't talk of that.
The season is not quite right.
There are not even enough leaves.
Do not shake this leaf.
This body of mine is still growing.
Wait until my wings grow in.

lines.zh: 这片叶还没啃完，急什么。
lines.en: This leaf isn't finished. What's the rush?
I hold a scrap of leaf.
I grip a leaf scrap and drag it to the center.

lines.zh: 地上没有叶子，我活不了。
lines.en: No leaf on the ground. I cannot survive.
This is only the crumbs I chewed.
I hug it with my front legs.
This is far heavier than I am.
I drag it back onto the leaf.
This leaf's edge is still wet.
Leave it. I cannot move it.
This is today's food.
The stem shakes, and it is not the wind.
I lift my head for a look.
I should not have left this leaf.
I am stuck at the leaf's edge.

lines.zh: 我钻到叶背，粉色的影子淡了。
lines.en: I slip beneath; my pink shadow fades.

lines.zh: 有股味道压过了叶子的青气。
lines.en: A smell drowns out the green of the leaf.
I only want to stay here.
Your shadow has come over me.
I squirm twice.
Too far to see clearly.
On the leaf, I dare not move.
My body is flat to the leaf.
You come near, and the leaf shakes.
I hide my head under the edge.
Pink is hard to hide.
I wait for the wind to carry me.
I hug the leaf edge, moving inch by inch.

lines.zh: 这片叶子还有一半能藏。
lines.en: Half the leaf is still cover.
Do not step on the stem.
I will stay like this for now.
I take a bite of the leaf.
I bump with my head.
I am soft, so I cannot push.
I only tore the leaf.

lines.zh: 我用头擦了擦你的手指。
lines.en: I rub your finger with my head.
That would not even tickle.
I shrink back and keep eating.
I bring my mouthparts close.
I push against your nail.
I landed on the leaf.
I am on the underside of this leaf.
A small pink strand. That is me.
The jungle leaves are thick.
I chewed a small hole first.
A bit of shell still clings nearby.
The sun does not reach here.

lines.zh: 叶子背面传来我的第一口啃食。
lines.en: My first bite sounds under the leaf.

lines.zh: 这片叶子摸上去是凉的。
lines.en: This leaf feels cool.
I crawl from the leaf's back toward its tip.
It is early. I must eat a lot.

lines.zh: 火气一过，我的绒毛焦了。
lines.en: The heat passes; my fuzz is singed.
I fell off the leaf.
Rain beats me down; I cling to the stem.
The blast shakes the leaf wildly.

lines.zh: 一支箭穿过叶子，擦到我。
lines.en: An arrow through the leaf grazed me.
This light fades my color.

lines.zh: 我啃到只剩叶脉，还是饿。
lines.en: I've chewed down to the vein and I'm still hungry.
The whole leaf lit up.
No leaf. I fell.
